newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Jan-Oct foreign investment up 32.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Jan-Oct foreign investment up 32.5 pct.

text.p: Foreign investment in South Korea rose 32.5 percent to $2.05 billion in the first 10 months of this year from $1.55 billion for the same 1995 period, the Finance and Economy Ministry said on Tuesday.
A ministry official said investment in the manufacturing sector rose to $1.1 billion from $753 million a year earlier.
The United States led others with an investment of $615 million, followed by the European Union with $551 million and Japan with $218 million, he said.
Last year, foreign investment in South Korea totalled $1.94 billion, up from $1.32 billion for the whole of 1994.
